About Veylet.

Veylet turns a walk through a property, captured on an iPhone, into a walkthrough people can explore from one link. It is built and run by its founder, Yo-Da Lai, in Brisbane, Australia.

Who runs it.

Yo-Da Lai founded Veylet and builds the app, the walkthrough player and this website. Emails to support@veylet.com are answered by a person, on working days in Brisbane time.

How the guides are written.

Each guide is drafted with AI assistance, then reviewed by Yo-Da Lai, who checks every figure and claim against the sources listed at the end of the guide. Each guide shows the date it was last checked. If you spot something wrong or out of date, email support@veylet.com and it will be corrected.

About our samples and ads.

The sample walkthrough on See a result is a research capture (Meta Eyeful Tower, MIT), not a client property, and it is labelled that way. Some of our social posts and ads use AI-generated scenes or AI voices; they are labelled, and they never stand in for real customers.
